summaries.en: z_image_turbo is a streamlined diffusion model designed for fast, high-quality image generation with minimal computational overhead. It employs a single-file architecture that simplifies deployment while maintaining competitive output quality through optimized inference pipelines. Developers can integrate it directly into applications like ComfyUI workflows or custom tools for rapid prototyping, making it ideal for real-time creative applications where speed matters more than maximum fidelity.
summaries.zh: z_image_turbo 是一个专为快速图像生成设计的精简扩散模型，通过单文件架构简化部署流程，在保持合理输出质量的同时显著降低计算需求。其技术核心在于优化推理管道，避免了复杂配置，使得模型能高效运行于普通硬件环境。用户可轻松将其集成到ComfyUI等可视化工具或自定义应用中，适用于需要实时反馈的创意场景，如快速概念草图生成或交互式艺术实验。
